summary: Both P1 findings are based on an older version of the plan that has since been updated. Finding P1 (plan.md:151-151) claims Task 1 defers removing birdeye_net_flow branches to Task 2, but plan.md:154 explicitly states 'in the same task' — the deferral no longer exists in the current plan. Finding P1 (task-manifest.json:Task 1) claims Task 1 does not declare breaking signature changes, but task-manifest.json lines 29-86 already enumerate all seven breaking signature changes (OnChainFlowFreshnessContext, WhaleSwapPayloadV1, WhaleTransferPayloadV1, StablecoinFlowPayloadV1, DexNetFlowPayloadV1, CexFlowProxyPayloadV1, OnChainFlowPayloadV1, AcceptedOnChainFlowSourceEvent) with breaking: true and descriptive notes. The plan is current and addresses both concerns.
rebuttal: Finding P1 (plan.md:151-151) is incorrect. The current plan.md:154 says 'remove the birdeye_net_flow branches from normalize.ts and threshold.ts and update normalize.test.ts to remove birdeye_net_flow fixture coverage in the same task — this avoids a typecheck failure'. The phrase 'in the same task' explicitly prevents the deferred-removal problem the finding describes. The finding references line 151 which shows the schema change but the branch-removal text on line 154 already covers the normalization code in the same step. Finding P1 (task-manifest.json:Task 1) is also incorrect. Task 1's signature_changes array (lines 29-86 of task-manifest.json) declares all seven breaking changes with breaking: true: OnChainFlowFreshnessContext, WhaleSwapPayloadV1, WhaleTransferPayloadV1, StablecoinFlowPayloadV1, DexNetFlowPayloadV1, CexFlowProxyPayloadV1, OnChainFlowPayloadV1, and AcceptedOnChainFlowSourceEvent. Each entry has a descriptive note explaining the breaking nature. The manifest was updated to address this concern before this review pass.
